pages.story: Ever seen a great friendship disappear over a silly fight? Watch closely!
Long ago, in a busy village, two friendly cats lived together.
Everyone loved their bond—they shared, played, and never fought.
But one day, while playing, one cat found a tasty piece of bread.
As she was about to eat, her friend cried, “Hey! Why didn’t you share with me?”
Feeling guilty, the first cat quickly broke the bread in two and offered a piece.
But her friend snapped, “Mine is smaller!”
Suddenly, the air filled with loud meows!
Other animals stopped to watch the drama.
Just then, Mintu the monkey swung down and grinned, “Why fight, dear cats? I have a weighing scale. I’ll help you share it fair and square.”
The cats agreed, hoping for a solution.
Mintu placed both pieces on the scale.
“Hmm, this one’s heavier!” *CHOMP!* He munched a bite.
Back and forth he nibbled, until just crumbs were left.
but Mintu smirked, “I need my pay!” and ate the last crumb.
The shocked cats stared at their empty paws, learning: When friends fight, tricksters win!
